title: Mission 1: Lyson Island
subtitle: Help Lyson Island with supplies.
summary: Watch the mission story, learn the parts, and assemble the airplane that carries supplies to Lyson Island.
activityInstruction: Drag each part onto the airplane body to build it.

storyQuestions.prompt: What problem are we trying to solve?

storyQuestions.success: An airplane can fly supplies to the island.

storyQuestions.prompt: Why do we need to build the airplane carefully?
answers: Each part helps it fly safely

storyQuestions.prompt: What should we learn before flying?
storyQuestions.success: Knowing the parts helps us build and fly.

quiz.prompt: What does the wing help the airplane do?
